render-mode.text:
Sales Mode

Set up different sales modes and assign them to terminals.

Need help? View guide
Sales modes are the price tiers a cashier picks while billing. Your shop already has Retail, Wholesale and Custom — most shops never change anything here. Retail charges MRP; Wholesale / Custom charge a fixed price you set per product in Product Prices. This screen is for advanced setup — creating a mode, or choosing which modes appear on each terminal.
Create Sales Mode
Active Sales Modes
Each sales mode can have different pricing rules and can be assigned to specific terminals.

label.text: Optional and OFF by default. Add a rule to require a customer on the bill and/or a minimum order value for a mode. Applies to THIS shop only — leaving a mode unlisted means no restriction (the default).
Select an active shop (organization) to manage its order rules.
